text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to prohibit parking at all times on the east side of Dayton Avenue, between Sinclair Street and the first laneway south of The Queensway. This is in response to a petition received from affected residents on Dayton Avenue and in consultation with the Ward Councillor.
Etobicoke York Community Council deferred consideration of this Item to its meeting on April 7, 2020.
